{{Top|leg}}
[[High Moff]] '''Morlish Veed's private office''' was located in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and had a direct view of the [[Temple of the Sith]]. In [[137 ABY]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Veed witnessed an [[Skirmish at the Temple of the Sith|attack]] on the Sith Temple orchestrated by [[Morrigan Corde]] and ordered [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]] to retreat from the fight as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had ordered that their airspace could not be trespassed. Also, after Veed was made [[Regent/Legends|Regent]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] Nyna Calixte met with him at his office. The two engaged in an argument in which Calixte chided him for making a deal the Sith without consulting it first with her, and reminded him that as Regent he would have to assume responsibility for any action carried out by the [[One Sith|Sith]]. The discussion resulted in Calixte being physically attacked by the enraged Regent.
